notes: Flow 1.3.3 (build 413). Fixes Flow closing as soon as it opens after updating from an older version; your tasks, water and workouts are kept. Also includes everything from build 411: workout music with a glass player, tasks that can ring as a real alarm, warm-ups, supersets, a set timer, PR stars, skip-day undo, a cleaner Settings with a Permissions page and icons on every button. Install over your existing Flow to keep your data.
